issue.title: build: improve UX when external dep build fails under Bazel.
issue.body:
The underlying issue is we aren't hard failing the build when a
repository_rule fails, which Bazel should presumably be doing, see
https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/3683.

The PR prints a brightly colored warning that provides guidance on where
to look to resolve the external dep failure. See
https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/10914751/30034498-f04e2dea-916f-11e7-9ab4-000c37f62307.png.

Fixes #1589.

body: Are you sure this the error that is triggered? Using with --nokeep_going should fail the build as soon as we hit the error. If not we definitely needs to investigate more.

I just checked, and even with `--nokeep_going` I get:

```
make: *** [/usr/local/google/home/htuch/.cache/bazel/_bazel_htuch/d994dfb436942cc737a6ac7e679f7c24/external/envoy_deps_cache_b3779303a90cb6b7115db282060da854/boringssl.dep] Error 1
make: Leaving directory `/usr/local/google/home/htuch/.cache/bazel/_bazel_htuch/d994dfb436942cc737a6ac7e679f7c24/external/envoy_deps'
WARNING: /usr/local/google/home/htuch/src/envoy-2/bazel/repositories.bzl:26:5: External dep build exited with return code: 1
WARNING: /usr/local/google/home/htuch/src/envoy-2/bazel/repositories.bzl:28:9:  External dependency build failed, check above log for errors and ensure all prerequisites at https://github.com/lyft/envoy/blob/master/bazel/README.md#quick-start-bazel-build-for-developers are met.
ERROR: error loading package 'source/exe': Encountered error while reading extension file 'protobuf.bzl': no such package '@protobuf_bzl//': no such package '@envoy_deps//thirdparty/protobuf': External dep build failed
ERROR: error loading package 'source/exe': Encountered error while reading extension file 'protobuf.bzl': no such package '@protobuf_bzl//': no such package '@envoy_deps//thirdparty/protobuf': External dep build failed
INFO: Elapsed time: 0.104s
FAILED: Build did NOT complete successfully (0 packages loaded)
    currently loading: source/exe
[2]    19637 exit 1     bazel build --nokeep_going //source/exe/...
```

If you look at https://github.com/lyft/envoy/blob/ec0591e9e6132c95b01f43b3bd9681db582b0e7d/bazel/repositories.bzl#L32, the build should have terminated after the second WARNING above. I do see the `fail` message, appended to a confusing ERROR message. This might be "working as intended", since it's probably catching the error while searching for the `protobuf_bzl` dependency and evaluating the rule, but I think a `fail` should be more prominent, indicating to the user the desired failure message (and then secondarily, have some stack information).
The build finish after the second warning but indeed the error are not really good, we should fix them.
